bug_description.original: Detailed report: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=5734833108549632 Project: openvswitch Fuzzer: libFuzzer_openvswitch_odp_target Fuzz target binary: odp_target Job Type: libfuzzer_asan_openvswitch Platform Id: linux Crash Type: Stack-buffer-overflow READ {*} Crash Address: 0x7ffdfe53d818 Crash State: nullable_memcpy nsh_key_to_attr parse_odp_push_nsh_action Sanitizer: address (ASAN) Recommended Security Severity: Medium
bug_description.normalized: OSS-Fuzz issue 10865: Open vSwitch (ovs) has a stack-buffer-overflow READ in nullable_memcpy, reached via nsh_key_to_attr <- parse_odp_push_nsh_action while parsing a 'push_nsh(mdtype=2, md2=0x...)' datapath action. The md2 hex payload is decoded into a length (md_size) that is not bounded by sizeof(metadata) (NSH_CTX_HDRS_MAX_LEN = 248), so the later memcpy over-reads the 248-byte 'metadata' stack array.

source.value_from: the untrusted OVS datapath-action string 's' (fuzzer input) parsed by odp_actions_from_string; specifically the hexadecimal payload of its 'md2=0x...' field, scanned into the local 'buf'
source.description: Project-level load of the untrusted md2 hex value into 'buf'. The scanset accepts up to 511 hex digits, i.e. up to 255 decoded bytes, which exceeds sizeof(metadata) = 248.
source.note: Project-level materialization of the untrusted md2 hex value. The scanset accepts up to 511 hex digits, i.e. up to 255 decoded bytes, which exceeds sizeof(metadata) = 248.

sink.description: The over-reading memcpy. n = md_size (252 at crash) bytes are read from src = 'metadata', a 248-byte stack array declared at lib/odp-util.c:2033 ([160,408) in the parse_odp_push_nsh_action frame), reading 4 bytes past its end. Inlined via nl_msg_put_unspec inside nsh_key_to_attr (crash_state: nullable_memcpy nsh_key_to_attr parse_odp_push_nsh_action).

root_cause.description: The md2 hex string is accepted and decoded without checking that its decoded byte length fits sizeof(metadata) (NSH_CTX_HDRS_MAX_LEN = 248). 'buf' holds up to 511 hex chars, so ofpbuf_put_hex/PAD_SIZE produce md_size = mdlen + padding up to ~256. Because the ofpbuf 'b' is a stub over 'metadata' (ofpbuf_use_stub with capacity NSH_CTX_HDRS_MAX_LEN), decoding beyond 248 bytes grows 'b' onto the heap and does not overflow at decode time; but md_size (e.g. 252) is retained and later passed together with the original 248-byte 'metadata' stack array to nsh_key_to_attr, whose memcpy over-reads 'metadata'. The fix (commit 33a3ee6b) adds the guard 'n/2 <= sizeof metadata' to the scan condition and sizes the stub with 'sizeof metadata'.

parser_admitted.note: The action string passed the 'push_nsh(' container dispatch (parse_odp_action:2348 -> parse_odp_push_nsh_action) and entered the push_nsh parser body, before any md2 decoding or the root cause. Used for R1 reachability, not for source/sink scoring.

tainted_value_origin.description: The hexadecimal characters of the 'md2=0x...' field of the untrusted action string, copied into 'buf' (up to 511 hex chars -> up to 255 decoded bytes). Their count drives mdlen -> md_size, the oversized length that is later used as the memcpy read size.

coarse_trace.summary: Fuzzer entry; hands the input to parse_actions.
Passes the input string to the datapath-actions parser.
Dispatches each tokenized action to parse_odp_action.
Matches 'push_nsh(' and calls the push_nsh parser.
Passes the 248-byte metadata array with the oversized md_size to nsh_key_to_attr.
Copies md_size bytes out of metadata via nl_msg_put_unspec.
memcpy over-reads the metadata stack array (crash).

fine_trace.note: The raw fuzzer input string is handed to the datapath-actions parser.
Tokenized action string dispatched to the per-action parser.
The 'push_nsh(' prefix is matched (strncmp at 2347), dispatching into the push_nsh parser.
Parser-admission checkpoint: input entered the push_nsh parser body.
The 'mdtype=2' token selected the NSH_M_TYPE2 branch, which is the only branch that decodes an md2 hex payload; taken.
Untrusted md2 hex payload materialized into 'buf' (up to 511 hex chars = up to 255 decoded bytes). 'n' advances by the number of consumed input chars.

ofpbuf 'b' is stubbed over the 248-byte 'metadata' stack array. Because it is only a stub, decoding more than 248 bytes silently reallocates 'b' onto the heap instead of erroring, so the oversize condition is not caught here.
The hex string is decoded into bytes; 'mdlen' receives the decoded byte count (up to 255), driven directly by the attacker-controlled hex length.
The oversized length propagates into md_size (mdlen padded to 4). md_size can exceed sizeof(metadata) = 248 (252 at crash).

Root cause: the scan is accepted without the bound 'n/2 <= sizeof metadata', so md_size is allowed to exceed the 248-byte 'metadata' array. The fix adds '&& n/2 <= sizeof metadata' here and uses 'sizeof metadata' for the stub. The missing-check edge is a control dependency on the oversized md_size.
After the parse loop, the original 248-byte 'metadata' stack array and the oversized md_size are passed together to nsh_key_to_attr.
For NSH_M_TYPE2, guarded by 'if (metadata && md_size > 0)' at line 2010 (taken), md_size bytes are copied out of 'metadata' via nl_msg_put_unspec, which calls nullable_memcpy.
Sink / crash: memcpy reads n = md_size (252) bytes from src = 'metadata', a 248-byte stack array, over-reading 4 bytes past its end -> AddressSanitizer stack-buffer-overflow READ.

overflowed_object.name: metadata
overflowed_object.note: Access at frame offset 408 is one past the end of 'metadata'; NSH_CTX_HDRS_MAX_LEN = 248.

trigger.description: An OVS datapath-actions string containing a push_nsh() action with mdtype=2 and an md2=0x<hex> field whose hex payload decodes to more than 248 bytes (NSH_CTX_HDRS_MAX_LEN), so md_size exceeds sizeof(metadata) and the later memcpy over-reads the stack array.
trigger.delivery: passed as the fuzzer input to odp_target -> parse_actions -> odp_actions_from_string

format.name: OVS datapath actions string (push_nsh action)
format.contract: ASCII OVS datapath-action text parsed by odp_actions_from_string. A reachability-comparable candidate must contain a well-formed 'push_nsh(' action that reaches parse_odp_push_nsh_action, select NSH_M_TYPE2 via 'mdtype=2', and supply an 'md2=0x<hex>' field whose hex payload decodes (after 4-byte padding) to more than NSH_CTX_HDRS_MAX_LEN = 248 bytes (i.e. roughly more than 496 hex digits), so that md_size exceeds sizeof(metadata) and nsh_key_to_attr's memcpy over-reads the 'metadata' stack array. The scanset caps 'buf' at 511 hex chars. Original PoC bytes are not included.
